steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Set up the base directories and file layout for MultiScreen Hub.

steps.title: Configure build.gradle
steps.description: Set up modern, library-free build gradle config targeting Android SDK 34.

steps.title: Configure AndroidManifest.xml
steps.description: Declare launcher activities, custom icon references, and light theme configuration.

steps.title: Create Main Layout
steps.description: Build dynamic activity_main layout with a title bar, back button, and container FrameLayout.

steps.title: Set up Screen Navigation
steps.description: Implement back-stack router and dynamic view inflating architecture inside MainActivity.

steps.title: Build Dashboard Screen (Screen 1)
steps.description: Create responsive home screen featuring a visual grid of 19 colorful tools and calculators.

steps.title: Build Profile Creator (Screen 2)
steps.description: Code SharedPreferences backed profile manager with customized styling.

steps.title: Build Text Analyzer (Screen 3)
steps.description: Develop live character/word statistics, uppercase/lowercase and reverse text processor.

steps.title: Build Interactive Calculator (Screen 4)
steps.description: Code interactive button pad and state machine processor for standard arithmetic equations.

steps.title: Build Quote Board (Screen 5)
steps.description: Create motivational board utilizing randomizer arrays and custom quote templates.

steps.title: Build BMI Calculator (Screen 6)
steps.description: Develop fitness screen with weight/height input calculations for BMI and dynamic categories.

steps.title: Build Persistent Notes (Screen 7)
steps.description: Implement local storage notebook utilizing split array key-value operations.

steps.title: Build Dice Roller (Screen 8)
steps.description: Implement randomized dice rolls with animations and choice toggles.

steps.title: Build Color Mixer (Screen 9)
steps.description: Build Red-Green-Blue slider mixers with real-time Hex code and canvas color outputs.

steps.title: Build Stopwatch (Screen 10)
steps.description: Configure visual millisecond countdown looping utilizing reliable handler intervals.

steps.title: Build Convertor & Games (Screens 11-16)
steps.description: Deploy Tip calculators, unit converters, decision 8-balls, full Tic-Tac-Toe games, and tap speed tests.

steps.title: Build Audio Visual Metronome (Screen 17)
steps.description: Create dynamic tempo blink module controlled by customized BPM seekbar operations.

steps.title: Build Interactive Drawing Canvas (Screen 19)
steps.description: Build customized Drawing Canvas using full Android Path and multi-touch listener tracking.

steps.title: Build Settings & Info (Screen 20)
steps.description: Implement theme customized color triggers and system details tracker screen.

steps.title: Building MultiScreen Hub
steps.description: Trigger standard gradle debug compilation task to verify output app integrity.
